methods.label: Pair corresponding terms
methods.explanation:
The even counting numbers begin \(2,4,6,\ldots\), and the odd counting numbers begin \(1,3,5,\ldots\). Each even number is exactly \(1\) greater than the odd number in the same position.

Pairing corresponding terms lets us subtract the sums without computing either large sum:
\[
(2-1)+(4-3)+\cdots+(4006-4005).
\]
There are \(2003\) pairs, each contributing \(1\). Therefore the difference is \(2003\cdot1=\boxed{2003}\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
methods.levelReason: Pairing corresponding terms and adding equal differences require only elementary arithmetic.
